title: Private Pilot — Glider
source: Starter Private Pilot Glider written vocabulary

terms.definition: Allows training under instructor supervision; required endorsements before solo.
Glider pilots generally do not need an FAA medical; know current sport/recreational/private glider medical rules that apply to you.
Systematic check of airframe, controls, instruments, and documents before flight.
Steps to assemble/disassemble a glider correctly and verify secure connections (pins, tape, controls).
Target height for joining and flying the landing pattern so energy management stays predictable.
Spot on the runway you fly toward on final; adjust spoilers/slip to control touchdown relative to it.
Landing/takeoff methods that protect the gear on soft or rough surfaces — keep weight off the wheel as appropriate.
Recognition of stalled, yawed flight and recovery priorities: reduce AOA, stop rotation, recover smoothly.
